parameters.content:
## Job alert bot — setup (5 min)
1. **Settings** node: put your email, Google Sheet ID, and tweak filters.
2. **Read Seen jobs / Save to … tab**: pick your *Google Service Account* credential. Sheet needs two empty tabs named **Jobs** and **Seen** (headers are created automatically).
3. **Gemini screen**: pick a *Google Gemini (PaLM) API* credential (free key from aistudio.google.com).
4. **Send email**: pick an *SMTP* credential (Gmail + app password).
5. Click **Execute workflow** once to test, then **Publish/Activate** it so it runs every hour.

### How it works
Collect jobs from YC, WeWorkRemotely, RemoteOK, Himalayas and company career APIs → keep software roles that aren't senior and work from India → skip anything already in **Seen** → Gemini checks experience (≤1 yr), location and salary (≥ ₹70k/month, unknown salary allowed) → save matches to **Jobs** and email them.

nodeGroups.name: Prepare new jobs

nodeGroups.name: Screen with AI
nodeGroups.description: Sends new jobs in small batches for an experience, location and salary check

nodeGroups.name: Record and notify matches
nodeGroups.description: Applies your rules, logs every checked job, saves matches to the sheet and emails them
